movie:1008392.overview: Seven black friends go away for the weekend, only to find themselves trapped in a cabin with a killer who has a vendetta. They must pit their street smarts and knowledge of horror movies against the murderer to stay alive.
movie:1008392.title: The Blackening

movie:1032892.overview: Three storylines, spanning thousands of years, intersect and reflect on hope, connection, and the circle of life.
movie:1032892.tagline: All we share, and all we experience, echoes across time.
movie:1032892.title: In the Blink of an Eye

movie:1290792.overview: After serving his country in the Army, Unique is falsely accused of assault and sent to prison. Once released, Unique sets up shop in Ohio to restart his life, linking up with his only surviving relative, Ramsey. There’s something insidious happening in this town, though, as its racist sheriff and his crew of similarly bigoted acolytes all have a knack for violence and share a gruesome secret pertaining to a recent string of missing young Black men. When they set their sights on Unique and turn his life upside down, the former soldier has no choice but to bring the ruckus down on the sheriff and his goons.
movie:1290792.tagline: He has nowhere to go. They have nowhere to hide.
movie:1290792.title: One Spoon of Chocolate

movie:1316092.overview: Tragedy strikes when Heathcliff falls in love with Catherine Earnshaw, a woman from a wealthy family in 18th-century England.
movie:1316092.title: “Wuthering Heights”

movie:1337592.overview: A romantic vacation goes awry when a volcanic eruption strands Bethany and her boyfriend, Rob, in Warsaw, Poland. Taking the explosive event as a sign to ditch her baggage, Bethany reunites with her childhood friend, Nel, to traipse through lofts, clubs, and back alleys—all while becoming entangled in an emotional web that challenges her sense of self.
movie:1337592.title: Erupcja

movie:14092.overview: In the year 2029, Section 9, a group of cybernetically enhanced cops, are called in to investigate and stop a highly-wanted hacker known as 'The Puppetmaster'.
movie:14092.title: Ghost in the Shell 2.0

movie:1429592.overview: Corinne Maclou is a background actor who dreams of one day being more than an extra. Confident her breakthrough is right around the corner, she befriends famous actor Sandrine Kiberlain, hoping it will help her achieve her goal.
movie:1429592.title: All About Corinne

movie:1435092.overview: Four siblings' lives change drastically when their ailing mother takes a turn for the worse over the holiday season.
movie:1435092.tagline: A good goodbye... It's all that matters.
movie:1435092.title: Goodbye June

movie:1515692.overview: In 1986 Madras, a timid eight-year-old boy accidentally traps a feared gangster inside a deserted school toilet. As the gangster is forced to confront hunger, loneliness and his own vulnerability, an unlikely bond begins to grow between the two.
movie:1515692.title: Baththa

movie:1665092.overview: During his training on the Original Star, Luo Feng faces constant threats from alien races coveting his strength and resources. Remaining calm and strategic, he uses both intelligence and power to counterattack and defend humanity’s honor. Wielding a formidable and beautiful battle blade, Luo Feng carves a path of destruction through his enemies, declaring, “I have a single strike that can sever the universe.”  As tensions escalate, the demon race, mechanical race, and insect race reappear and form a three-race alliance. Their leaders, along with 6,000 universe-level experts, join forces to encircle and eliminate Luo Feng. In the face of overwhelming odds, Luo Feng unleashes his ultimate technique, “I Am the Universe,” annihilating the coalition in one decisive strike.
movie:1665092.title: Swallowed Star The Movie  - Battle on Primal Star

movie:1715492.overview: Never-before-seen footage and survivor accounts trace the 2012 shipwreck of a luxury cruise and the disaster that ensued, in this immersive documentary.
movie:1715492.title: Shipwrecked: Nightmare at Sea

movie:186992.title: Stranger by the Lake

movie:272692.overview: Michael King asks occultists to summon all evil spirits to prove his point that they do not exist. But something goes wrong and he becomes a danger to everyone.

movie:272692.title: The Possession of Michael King

movie:630392.overview: In the late 19th century, a brutal land baron slaughters a Roma clan, unleashing a curse on his family and village. In the days that follow, the townspeople are plagued by nightmares, the baron's son goes missing, and a boy is found murdered. The locals suspect a wild animal, but a visiting pathologist warns of a more sinister presence lurking in the woods.
movie:630392.title: The Cursed

movie:644092.overview: Two Brooklyn siblings' summer in a rural Oahu town takes an exciting turn when a journal pointing to long-lost treasure sets them on an adventure, leading them to reconnect with their Hawaiian heritage.

When a slime who evolved into a Demon Lord named Rimuru Tempest crosses paths with Hiiro, a survivor of the Ogre race, an incredible adventure packed with new characters begins. The power of bonds will be put to the test!
movie:876792.tagline: The power of bonds will be put to the test!
movie:876792.title: That Time I Got Reincarnated as a Slime the Movie: Scarlet Bond

tv:110492.overview: The continuing story of Peacemaker, a vainglorious superhero/supervillain who believes in peace at any cost — no matter how many people he has to kill. After a miraculous recovery from his duel with Bloodsport, Peacemaker soon discovers that his freedom comes at a price.
tv:110492.title: Peacemaker

tv:2192.overview: Robotech is an 85-episode adaptation of three different anime television series made between 1982-1984 in Japan; the adaptation was aired in 1985. Within the combined and edited story, Robotechnology refers to the scientific advances discovered in an alien starship that crashed on a South Pacific island. With this technology, Earth developed giant robotic machines or mecha to fight three successive extraterrestrial invasions.
tv:2192.title: Robotech

tv:32692.overview: A drama about a multi-generational family of cops dedicated to New York City law enforcement. Frank Reagan is the New York Police Commissioner and heads both the police force and the Reagan brood. He runs his department as diplomatically as he runs his family, even when dealing with the politics that plagued his unapologetically bold father, Henry, during his stint as Chief.
tv:32692.tagline: Honor. Justice. Family. It's in their blood.
tv:32692.title: Blue Bloods

tv:61692.overview: A '90s-set single-camera comedy about a hip-hop-loving Asian kid growing up in suburban Orlando, being raised by an immigrant father obsessed with all things American and an immigrant mother often bewildered by white culture.
tv:61692.title: Fresh Off the Boat

tv:8592.overview: In an attempt to beautify her town — and advance her career — Leslie Knope, a mid-level bureaucrat in the Parks and Recreation Department of Pawnee, Indiana, takes on bureaucrats, cranky neighbors, and single-issue fanatics whose weapons are lawsuits, the jumble of city codes, and the democratic process she loves so much.
tv:8592.tagline: Because parks don't grow on trees.
tv:8592.title: Parks and Recreation
